title: Lena and the Atlas
author: Beatrix Marchetti
blurb: Vesper Yarrow, a suffragist's driver who reads every letter before delivering it, has spent twelve years learning which silences keep people safe. But when a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must choose which family member gets the last berth before the century turns.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
